methods: Construct one side-correction word at an explicit chronological cut with the needed frames still available.

original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one exact side-correction cut and bound its allowed cost from a favorable completed moment at a declared target. Stop or hand off if the necessary source/target access cannot be justified or even the optimistic total misses the target.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Completing an already realized changed channel tests a concrete construction opportunity, instead of refining the incumbent packing. A positive local result still needs global and all-size admission.
allowed_variations: One correction factorization, one chronological cut, or one explicit hosting obstruction.
A changed correction schedule with an updated full bill and native frame contract.
scope_change_triggers: Recompiling the already certified low-rank channel without closing a new obligation.
Treating a pending ancestor, local histogram or unpriced side correction as an admitted global supplier.

actual_scope: Prove a directed-chart-alphabet communication obstruction for arbitrary retimings and common-chart linear mixing of the native P104 word; independently certify its eight crossing occurrences.
scope_change_reason: The live revision-4 handoff in PR2090 and PR2082 explicitly leaves retiming open. A dependency-order probe found that the cut survives even after dropping every time/role constraint, so the delivered proof uses the stronger directed chart alphabet instead of the frozen event chronology.
bottleneck_link: A complete identity needs source-to-target rank 104 per array dimension. The unchanged directed alphabet carries at most eight with the retained drops, so rescheduling or scalar tuning alone cannot complete this P104 channel. A successful successor must change a directed transport type or the counted message capacity.
stop_rule: Stop this route once the chronology-free separator is proved and independently checked, or an actual executable bypass is found; do not run a large scheduling search after an alphabet obstruction.
evidence: RESULT.json binds 444 charts, 740 directed types, 1410 occurrences, the 222-chart reachable set and eight rank-seven crossing occurrences. Two code-disjoint implementations agree and replay all 280 formal input columns; no full supplier or kappa is claimed.
